title: Danmuji Fried Skillet
description: A sweet and savory breakfast dish featuring danmuji and lazy day potatoes. Perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced danmuji and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until slightly caramelized.
Add the sliced green onions and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced lazy day potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they're tender and lightly browned.
Add the soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the danmuji fried skillet to a serving dish and garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
